LESSON: PHYSICAL FEATURES IN THE COUNTY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Natural and Built Environments
Topic 1.3: Physical features in the County
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Physical features in the County, part of Natural and Built Environments in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why are physical features important for a County?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Physical features in the County together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Citizenship: Learners identify the main physical features in their county.

● Learning to learn: Learners find out from parents or guardians the physical features in the county and share.

Values:
● Social Justice: Learners Accords equal opportunities in sharing responsibilities as they discuss in groups the importance of the main

physical features in the county and share the discussion points in class.

● Love: Learners Puts the interest of others before their own interest as they use digital resources with assistive technology to draw or take

photographs of the main physical features in the county.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Self-Awareness: Learners appreciate others uniqueness while modelling some of the main physical features in the county.

● Citizenship: Learners engage effectively with others as they display pictures or models of the main physical features in the county in

class.

Links to other Learning Areas:
● English, Kiswahili and KSL as learners discuss in groups the importance of the main physical features in the county and share the

discussion points in class.

Suggested Learning Resources

• Model of a compass

• Photographs

• Vetted digital devices with assistive technology

• Plasticine

• Wet clay

• Cameras

• Display boards.
